findings.title: File map still omits a new test file (test_client_state_projections.py), the two vault_min fixture pages, and 5 of the ops scripts - the residual of G0A-16/G0A2-11 that the integrator reported as fully fixed
findings.evidence: Empirical: the fully-materialised tree contains exactly 42 new-or-modified tracked paths (matching the integrator's '42 tracked paths'), but 7 of them are named nowhere in the plan's `## File map` section. Four are legitimately covered by the glob row `scripts/brain/tests/fixtures/client_state/*.json`. The remaining three are not: `scripts/brain/tests/test_client_state_projections.py` (a NEW TEST FILE created by Task 15, contributing 8 of the suite's tests) and the two fixture pages `scripts/brain/tests/fixtures/client_state/vault_min/raw/areas/clearworks/org-brain/clients/{acme,alloi}.md` (the glob is *.json and does not reach into vault_min/). The ops row lists only {shims/cortextos, shims/gws-trap, g1-count-delta.sh, g4-check.sh, coverage-diff.py, cron-precheck.sh, test_coverage_diff.py} and omits shims/claude-trap, test-ops-shims.sh, g4-gen-fixture.py, mutation-check.sh and fixtures/crons-{2026-08-11,bad}.json; it also misfiles test_coverage_diff.py under docs/pipeline/run-artifacts/ when it actually lives at scripts/brain/tests/. Verified absent by string search over the File map section. NOT Critical: g1-count-delta.sh never reads the File map - it takes explicit `+files +tests +pytest` deltas as arguments and re-runs the suite - so no gate mechanically breaks; the cost is that a builder deriving G1's +files from the File map under-counts by one test file.
findings.fix: Add `test_client_state_projections.py` to the per-slice Create row, add a `vault_min/**` line (or widen the fixture glob to `fixtures/client_state/**`), and complete the ops row to all 9 scripts + the 2 cron fixtures; move test_coverage_diff.py out of the run-artifacts brace.

This is the Step-2 residual of G0A2-12, whose fix re-derived Step-4 counts only. For contrast, every other Step-2 RED claim I checked reproduced exactly: Task 3 stated '9 passed, 7 failed' -> actual '7 failed, 9 passed'; Task 4 '16 failed' -> '16 failed'; Task 5 '4 failed, 18 passed' -> '4 failed, 18 passed'; Task 20's stated `TypeError: main() takes 0 positional arguments but 1 was given` -> exactly that TypeError on all 3 tests.
findings.fix: Replace the Task 19 Step-2 wave2 note with a count re-derived in task order from the plan's own blocks (8 failed, 8 passed), or delete the sandbox note and keep only the primary Expected line.
